verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. For K6, the pigeonhole argument guarantees three same-colored edges incident to a chosen vertex, and the ensuing case split always yields a monochromatic triangle. For K5, the red edges and complementary blue edges are explicitly identified as 5-cycles, each of which is triangle-free. These two parts establish the matching upper and lower bounds R(3,3) <= 6 and R(3,3) > 5. The statement is self-contained, the proof uses no external references or internal fact IDs, and none of the hard prohibitions applies.
